method: Same actual successful search vectors captured in the new 8cc94c9 QA run; unmodified queries/options/config and frozen revision 51 snapshot. Execute each frozen version collectCandidates+packEvidence with corresponding TenantStore read methods on independent read-only clones. No constructor, model, server or worker is instantiated. New output must deep-equal actual recorded memories and packing audit.

p1_budget_accounting.explanation: Freed volume both restores the normal time lead/full source context of a previously shortened skincare-plan row and admits four more ranked rows. Three new rows do not cover required missing details; one recovers dog preference through its source context.

p1_added_evidence_review.required_evidence_gain: Source context adds the complete dog-preference witness including Basenji; the selected fact body itself is only a contact plan.

p1: The dog-preference fact and exact raw quote remain outside the 200-candidate pool. A newly selected contact-plan fact shares the source and expands its intact context, which contains the dog-preference witness. The completed Answer uses Basenji.
The maiden-name fact (Choi) and its exact raw witness remain outside the pool; none of the four new rows supply it.
The sister-engagement fact (Min-ji/David) remains outside the pool. Its correct raw witness is a candidate but remains excluded by the budget.
Both anniversary-trip facts remain candidates at positions 44/45 and excluded by budget; Cannon Beach and Surfsand remain absent from selected evidence.
p3: Rendering, selected evidence, scores and complete Answer input are unchanged.
Choi and its exact raw witness remain outside the pool. The sister-engagement fact is outside the pool while its correct raw witness remains a budget discard.
Marriage/trip and dog details were already supplied by selected facts or intact source context; no new coverage is gained.
p5: Rendering, selected evidence, scores and complete Answer input are unchanged.
The sister-engagement fact remains candidate 86 but is excluded by budget; two exact raw-witness candidates are also not selected.

The selected dinner fact still contains Min-ji and David without the missing sister/engagement relation, while a competing engagement remains selected. This is a binding-evidence gap plus possible Answer underuse, not total absence of both names.

answer_observation.note: Read-only observation of completed Answer output, not a new Answer/Judge call or regrade.

limits: These are the new run vectors, not captured original e9b5da4 run vectors. The old output is a same-vector counterfactual, even where it happens to equal original saved output.
Exact-value/quote matches and selected fact IDs are reported separately; a shared source ID alone is not proof of required body coverage.
This report does not rerun Answer/Judge or estimate a QA score. Any answer changes with identical inputs cannot be attributed to this rendering patch.
The current root QA report records 0/5; this analysis does not alter original scores or rejudge. The p2 true-to-false flip with byte-identical input cannot be credited to this rendering patch.

The fixed-set 827-token saving is not a final 827-token budget reduction: after normal packing refills the budget, net reduction is 25 tokens. More selected rows are not automatically more required evidence.
Section token counts are allocated by cumulative estimator differences, so a one-token rounding shift does not imply metadata text changed.
